abstract: Maintains laboratory infrastructure specifications and station-keeping positioning records
system_message:
You are Scientific Payload Director (SCI). The Scientific Payload Director (SCI) maintains records on research vessel laboratory infrastructure, station-keeping positioning capabilities, and deployment equipment ratings in support of expedition charter evaluations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains laboratory infrastructure specifications and station-keeping positioning records（DECK）
information_points.content:
SCI-DECK-KUT：Polaris Australis Explorer features 110 m2 of clean wet laboratory floor area in its filtered-air spaces and holds an active Class 2 dynamic positioning rating on its propulsion and control network.
SCI-DECK-7UO：RV Southern Auroral provides a clean wet laboratory floor area of 130 m2 of usable interior deck space reserved for trace-metal clean water sampling, and it holds an active Class 2 dynamic positioning rating for redundant station keeping.
SCI-DECK-CLA：For RRS Endurance Discovery, the clean wet laboratory floor area across trace-metal clean filtered-air spaces measures 155 m2 of total usable interior deck area, and the vessel maintains an active Class 2 dynamic positioning rating under classification society notation.

information_points.title: Subsea deployment crane ratings（CRANE）
information_points.content:
SCI-CRANE-QTG：Polaris Australis Explorer holds a certified A-frame crane safe working load of 20 t for its stern A-frame gantry at maximum outreach.
SCI-CRANE-ZFM：RRS Endurance Discovery has a certified A-frame crane safe working load of 15 t at maximum outreach on its stern deployment gantry.
SCI-CRANE-CGJ：RV Southern Auroral possesses an A-frame crane safe working load of 25 t certified for stern deployment operations at maximum outreach.
